# Installed with --no-deps after requirements.txt. Each one declares a
# dependency the environment deliberately leaves out:
# - ultralytics and hand_tracking_toolkit declare opencv-python, which would
#   install a second cv2 over opencv-python-headless.
# - hamer declares detectron2, mmcv==1.3.9, chumpy and xtcocotools, used only by
#   its demo (ViTDet person detector, ViTPose) and by MANO pickles that the
#   environment replaces with chumpy-free copies (tools/models/mano_dechumpy.py).
ultralytics==8.4.6
hand_tracking_toolkit @ git+https://github.com/facebookresearch/hand_tracking_toolkit@bc628e9286c18444b47a0971a89d075ea6f00747
hamer @ git+https://github.com/geopavlakos/hamer@3a01849f4148352e9260b69bf28b65d1671a4905
# NVRC (G5's neural-background oracle, vendored in opt/NVRC by env/nvrc.sh).
# compressai 1.2.6, NVRC's pin, ships only a source archive that fails to build
# here; 1.2.8 has a cp312 manylinux_2_34 wheel (hosts run glibc 2.35) and the
# same entropy-model and rANS API. Installed without dependencies because the
# resolver would otherwise replace torch 2.10.0+cu128; compressai's declared
# pybind11, tomli, setuptools>=68 and wheel are build-time only.
# torch-geometric (with pandas and xxhash) is imported by compressai at import
# time. accelerate 1.3.0 is NVRC's pin; its other dependencies are present.
compressai==1.2.8
accelerate==1.3.0
pytorch-msssim==1.0.0
torch-geometric==2.8.0.post1
pandas==3.0.6
xxhash==4.0.1
